persona_statements: I m a pilot for Southwest. I met my wife at a nickleback concert. My favorite food is fried chicken. I have a twin sister named Jessica.
I am a father. I work many hours. My favorite band is imagine dragons. I like basketball.

I look forward to retiring. My wife always puts a smile on my face. I love all of my beautiful children. I tried to make it as an actor when I was younger. I am a humble baker.
I enjoy my steaks cooked medium rare. I've the gene that lets me know when someone s eaten asparagus. I've five different flavors of coffee in my fridge. I m too short to reach the top shelf.
